# Registers

Every `.tsv` register in the tree, with the columns, key and references its row in `standards/naming/schemas.tsv` declares.
Read one by column name with `sh bin/standard-register.sh get <file> <column>...`; a register with no row, a row with no file and a
reference to an id that is not there are each red (`standard.register-declared`, `standard.reference-resolves`).

| Register | Owner | Key | Columns | References | Read by | What it holds |

| `standards/naming/terms.tsv` | standard | id | `id class pref broader vsm stability successor src alt depends_on definition` | broader>standards/naming/terms.tsv:id successor>standards/naming/terms.tsv:id depends_on>standards/naming/terms.tsv:id@, | `bin/lint-name.sh` | a word and every closed set |
| `standards/naming/aliases.tsv` | standard | id | `id term kind surfaces remove_by note` | - | `bin/lint-name.sh` | a confined or rejected spelling and the term to use |
